paper_title: Analysis of atomic-clock data to constrain variations of fundamental constants
coupling_convention: dimensionless d_gamma^(1) (Damour-Donoghue convention, coupling normalized to gravitational strength kappa = 1/(sqrt(2) M_P))
notes: Paper constrains multiple couplings (d_gamma, d_me-d_g, d_q-d_g, Higgs A, axion-gluon 1/f_a); the headline new exclusion is on the linear scalar-photon coupling d_gamma^(1) from Yb+/Sr clock ratio data, claimed to improve prior limits by ~1 order of magnitude for 1e-20 <= m_phi <= 1e-17 eV. No numerical exclusion table is given; data points were reconstructed from the text formula d^(1) = zeta^(1)_f * A_alpha(f) with zeta^(1)_f ~= 2.0e16 f/Hz and the global amplitude bound A_alpha(f) <= 5.6e-18 (1-sigma false-alarm level; the figure shows a slightly higher 95% C.L. curve, so these values are approximate to within a factor ~1.5). Frequency-to-mass via m = 4.136e-15 * f[Hz] over the stated range 2.5e-6 Hz to 1.7e-2 Hz. SHM with rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed; stochastic amplitude factor ~3 stated to be accounted for.
